name: always move to the nearest unvisited
mechanism: from the current position repeatedly go to the closest not-yet-visited element until all are visited

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Nearest neighbour algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs:

fails_when: the last legs can be arbitrarily long; no approximation bound
